definitions.explanation: Edible sea creatures, especially fish and shellfish served fresh.

examples.japanese: {海鮮|かいせん}{丼|どん}を{食|た}べた。
examples.english: I ate a seafood rice bowl.

examples.japanese: {新鮮|しんせん}な{海鮮|かいせん}が{手|て}に{入|はい}る。
{海鮮|かいせん}{市場|いちば}に{行|い}った。
examples.english: I went to the seafood market.

notes:
COLLOCATIONS:
- {海鮮|かいせん}{丼|どん}: seafood rice bowl
- {海鮮|かいせん}{鍋|なべ}: seafood hot pot
- {海鮮|かいせん}サラダ: seafood salad
- {海鮮|かいせん}{市場|いちば}: seafood market

RELATED:
- {魚介類|ぎょかいるい}: seafood (more formal/categorical term)
